name: Cummins 5285862 24V alternator
source: Prestolite Electric / Leece-Neville OEM alternator specification; use as a reference profile for a 24V high-output installation, not as a factory alarm setpoint
notes: Brushless, high-efficiency 24V alternator intended for heavy-duty Cummins marine and industrial service. The gauges below are a conservative reference set for monitoring output voltage, charging current, power delivery, and temperature. Set any warn or alarm thresholds from your vessel's service manuals before using this profile as active alarm logic.
